column1: # Edition-specific numbering that TVTMS does not cover. Each row is verified by
# pipeline/sample_ingest.py against a parallel edition's text before it is trusted.
# Brenton part letters are stored by position (TVTMS letters a..z without gaps); Brenton's own
# labels (which skip j and v) are kept in verse.source_ref.
# Swete prints Greek Esther's additions as separate numbered runs: Addition A as a 'prologue'
# chapter (stored as chapter 0), B-E as lettered runs inside their host chapters. Standard
# (TVTMS/NRSV, Vulgate-style) numbering per the TVTMS notes: A1-11=11:2-12, A12-17=12:1-6,
# Each row is checked against Brenton's text at the same Standard verse.
# WEB prints Susanna and Bel as Greek Daniel 13 (64 verses) and 14 (42 verses). TVTMS only has a
# Latin-tradition rule for Dan 14 (where 13:65 holds Bel 1:1), whose test also matches the WEB.
# WEB 14:1 is Bel 1:1; checked structurally (42 verses) in build_bible.py.

column5: WEB Daniel 14 = Bel and the Dragon 1-42

column1: # Brenton numbers Tob 4:8-18 as 4:7a-7l (stored by position as 4:7a-k).
# Brenton Esther 1: base 1:1 = Addition A1; parts (printed 1b-1s, stored a-q) = A2-A17, then Esther 1:1.
# (Swete's Letter of Jeremiah is aligned to Brenton's by text in build_bible.py: Swete prints the
# title as a heading and divides 1:43-50 differently, so no fixed offset is right.)
# TVTMS merges Swete's (undivided) Esther 1:1 with Addition A; in Swete Addition A is the prologue.

column5: Swete Esther 1:1 (Addition A is the prologue)

column1: # Swete Esther 10: the Hebrew text 10:1-3 is printed as 10:1a-3a, Addition F as plain 10:1-11
# WEB Greek Esther prints the additions inside or after ordinary verses, in places TVTMS doesn't
# expect (B in 3:13, D in 5:1 and F as 10:4-14 are mapped correctly by TVTMS). Evidence from verse
# lengths and structure, checked in build_bible.py: 1:1 is 370 words (Hebrew 1:1 has 13) and holds
# Addition A; 4:18-47 are 30 verses after Hebrew 4:17 = Addition C (30 verses); 8:12 is the plain
# verse (20 words); 8:13 is 688 words and holds Addition E (the king's letter).

column5: WEB Greek Esther 1:1 includes Addition A
WEB Greek Esther 8:12 is the plain verse
WEB Greek Esther 8:13 includes Addition E
